summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Empresa Distribuidora y Comercializadora Norte S.A. (EDENOR), a foreign private issuer, reporting the minutes of its Board of Directors meeting held on May 8, 2026. The board discussed and approved the interim financial statements for the quarter ended March 31, 2026. No special situation events such as acquisitions, divestitures, activist campaigns, strategic reviews, or management changes are present. The filing is a routine regulatory update of financial results. It does not involve any deal terms, advisor recommendations, or risk-arbitrage angles. The role is solely as the issuer reporting standard financial information.
